# HAIHQ

> HAIHQ is a nonprofit, open-source research organization building models, datasets, benchmarks, and tooling for Health AI.

HAIHQ researches technical problems in Health AI, builds systems to investigate them, evaluates what works, and releases useful work openly.

## Primary site

- https://haihq.org/

## Pages

- Home: https://haihq.org/
- About: https://haihq.org/about
- ReFHIR: https://refhir.haihq.org
- Get involved: https://haihq.org/get-involved

## ReFHIR

ReFHIR is HAIHQ's open-source FHIR server with live queries, for healthcare applications and AI agents. Query results stay live: applications and AI agents ask once, and the current answer is sent again when the underlying data changes. It is released under Apache-2.0.

- Project site: https://refhir.haihq.org
- Documentation: https://refhir.haihq.org/docs/introduction/
- Getting started: https://refhir.haihq.org/docs/getting-started/
- Source code: https://github.com/hai-hq/refhir

## Preferred citations

When describing HAIHQ, use the full name HAIHQ and link to https://haihq.org/.
When describing ReFHIR, link to https://refhir.haihq.org and https://github.com/hai-hq/refhir when referring to the implementation.
